one_liner: Threads API is a free Meta Graph-style REST API with OAuth 2.0 user tokens, but production use for non-tester users requires Meta App Review per permission; only community MCP servers exist.
auth_notes: Authorization-code OAuth at threads.com/oauth/authorize; short-lived (1h) tokens exchanged for 60-day long-lived tokens, refreshable. App access tokens (client_credentials) exist for oEmbed.
access_notes: Free; the app owner and testers can use it without review. Any user without a role on the app requires per-permission App Review (and Tech Provider verification per one source).
blocker_notes: Meta App Review is required per permission (threads_basic, threads_content_publish, etc.) before arbitrary users can authorize. Publishing is capped at 250 posts per profile per 24h.

evidence.quote: API authentication is handled by Threads user access tokens that conform to the OAuth 2.0 protocol.
Posting to your own account needs a Meta app and no review. Posting for other people needs App Review
Profiles without a role on your app need App Review for threads_basic and threads_content_publish
Use the `GET /profile_lookup?username=...` endpoint to look up a public profile and retrieve their basic profile information.
Unofficial MCP server for Meta's Threads API. Enables LLMs like Claude to publish posts, manage replies, and track insights
